translations.web: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus gave strict orders that no one should know about this, and He told them to give her something to eat.
translations.kjv: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.
translations.asv: And he charged them much that no man should know this: and he commanded that something should be given her to eat.
